title: Pullman's 18th Street wall stands as it did around 1900
items: In 1904 the low stone wall before Pullman's palm house and stable runs as one plain, level coping. A photograph from about 1900 shows it that way, with a thick border of shrubs behind it.
The tall piers, the urn and the curved low walls from the 1894 pictures are gone east of the porch stair. Both gateways stay, including the carriage way into the stable court.
